text: Employees are entitled to 20 days of annual leave per calendar year. Leave must be requested at least 2 weeks in advance through the HR portal.
Sick leave is unlimited with a doctor's note for absences longer than 3 consecutive days. Short-term sick leave (1-3 days) requires only manager notification.
Parental leave provides 12 weeks paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers, available within the first year of birth or adoption.
Business travel must be pre-approved by a director. Economy class is standard for flights under 6 hours; business class requires VP approval.
Meal per diem is $75/day domestic, $100/day international. Receipts required for expenses over $25. Alcohol is not reimbursable.
All expenses must be submitted within 30 days of incurred date. Corporate card preferred; personal card reimbursements require itemized receipts.
Ground transportation: use rideshare or public transit. Rental cars require prior approval. Parking and tolls are reimbursable with receipts.
Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Full remote requires director approval and annual review.
Remote workers must be available during core hours 10am-3pm ET. Company provides $500 annual stipend for home office equipment.
All employees must treat colleagues with respect. Harassment, discrimination, and retaliation are prohibited. Report violations to HR or ethics hotline.
